dial.summary: Bitcoin crashed below $77K on October 30 amid an unconfirmed Binance hack scare that triggered $1.49B in liquidations (86.8% longs per CoinGlass), breaking TOTAL crypto market cap lower; September PCE ran hot at 3.6% YoY alongside strong Q3 GDP of 3.4%, reinforcing December hiking odds and sustaining DXY (101.74) and real yield (2.64%) headwinds; Global M2 rising to $104.3T and the Fed balance sheet stable at $6.75T provide a macro offset, but the crypto-specific structural breakdown and macro tightening backdrop shift the dial to Risk Off.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$104,317B (~$104.3T) for September 2026 (MacroMicro Sep 2026; up from August $103.66T = +$0.65T, +0.6% MoM); US M2 at $23.41T in September 2026 (H.6, +5.7% YoY from $22.15T); 4-week trend UP (August $103.7T → September $104.3T confirmed; US M2 Oct weekly tracker near $23.5T); status supportive (4-week trend is up); FRED API blocked this run; next full G4 October aggregate expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August was 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October 2026 ISM PMI due November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; S&P Global flash US Manufacturing PMI for October came in at 56.0 (up from 55.9 in September, a separate index from ISM); status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week ISM basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.74 on October 30, 2026 (Trading Economics; ChainCatcher Oct 29 close ~101.70 after a 0.27% fall; FXStreet had ~102.25 during early European trading Oct 29); Q3 GDP 3.4% and September PCE 3.6% YoY (released Oct 29) reinforced December 8–9 hike expectations, keeping dollar bid; BOJ held at 1.25% Oct 30 with hawkish December signal; 4-week trend UP (Sep 26 ~100.5 → Oct 30 ~101.74, +1.2%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); FRED DTWEXBGS API blocked this run.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at ~2.64% on Oct 29, 2026 (Au79 Macro Research Oct 29; Watchgold Oct 26 = 2.66%); 10Y breakeven at 2.38% (Admiral Markets Oct 28) implies real yield consistent with 10Y nominal ~5.02%; Q3 GDP 3.4% and Sep PCE 3.6% YoY released Oct 29 support sustained headwind; 4-week trend FLAT (Sep 26 ~2.62–2.65% vs Oct 29 ~2.64%, < 5bps change within flat threshold); status headwind (above 2% threshold); FRED API blocked this run.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: Oct 29, 2026: 10Y=4.98%, 2Y=4.61%, spread=+37bps (Forbes; corroborated by sofrrate.com Oct 28: 10Y=5.05%, 2Y=4.67%, +38bps); Q3 GDP 3.4% and Sep PCE 3.6% YoY released Oct 29 reinforced December 8–9 hiking expectations; 4-week trend DOWN (Sep 26 ~+42bps → Oct 30 ~+37bps, −5bps flattening); status neutral (positive but flattening, well above −50bps inversion threshold); curve remains in positive territory reflecting the improving growth backdrop.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: Latest confirmed WALCL: $6,753,604M ($6.754T) for week ending October 21, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 22; Oct 14 ~$6.76T; Sep 30 $6.743T); Oct 28 H.4.1 (due Oct 29) not confirmed in public sources at time of run; FRED API blocked this run; 4-week trend flat (Sep 30 $6.743T → Oct 21 $6.754T = +$11B, +0.16%); status supportive (flat, post-QT-pause stabilization plateau).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass snapshot showing OI-weighted BTC perp funding at ~0.0079% per 8h alongside BTC ~$78,904 (pre-crash); on October 30, BTC crashed below $77K amid an unconfirmed Binance hack scare, triggering $1.49B in total liquidations (86.8% longs, per CoinGlass via CryptoRank); post-liquidation funding likely near zero or negative; 30-day trend DOWN (prior ~0.0088% per 8h → ~0.0079% and declining post-crash); well below the 0.04% headwind threshold; status supportive (low leverage, post-flush environment).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$297.9B (DefiLlama Oct 29); total crypto estimated ~$2.59T (BTC near $77K post-crash, BTC.D ~59.5% per TV-Hub October 2026 pre-crash); implied dominance ~11.5% ($298B / $2.59T); 30-day trend UP (Sep 23 ~10.5% → Oct 30 ~11.5%); rising dominance primarily reflects declining total crypto market cap (BTC crash on Binance hack scare, $1.49B liquidations Oct 30) rather than fear-driven stablecoin inflows; status neutral (headwind condition requires rising TOTAL, which is declining).

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first read on Q4 manufacturing activity and the first post-FOMC PMI print; September ISM was 54.5% with Prices Paid at 77.9% (multi-year high); S&P Global flash Manufacturing PMI for October came in at 56.0, suggesting resilience; Polymarket consensus at time of creation clustered in 52.0–52.9 range; a print above 55 adds to December hike case, below 52 would suggest deceleration.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases September 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) at 10:00 AM ET — pairs with the September NFP of +29K (weakest of the cycle) to give a fuller labor market picture; a sharp drop in job openings below 7M would add evidence of labor softening and complicate the December 8–9 FOMC hiking narrative; quits rate will also be watched for signs of worker confidence.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases the October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of the official BLS NFP on November 6; September NFP came in at +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below +90K consensus); an ADP beat above 100K would raise expectations for October NFP and reinforce December hiking odds; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns and likely cap DXY and real yields.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first post-FOMC services activity read; released same day as ADP; a combined strong Services PMI and ADP beat would solidify December 8–9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds; services sector accounts for ~70% of US GDP, so a miss below 50 would be an outsized macro signal.

upcoming.title: Bank of England Rate Decision (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of England MPC announces Bank Rate decision at 12:00 PM UK time (with Monetary Policy Report) — current Bank Rate at 3.75% (held at September 17 meeting, 6-3 vote with three members backing a hike); markets pricing ~69% probability of no change; a surprise hike would strengthen GBP, add to global tightening pressure, and ease DXY headwinds for risk assets; final 2026 BOE decision follows December 17.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 1 — released same day as the BOE decision and one day before October NFP (November 6); final labor-market read before the NFP print; any sharp spike above 230K would temper December 8–9 FOMC hike expectations and could amplify risk-off in crypto following the October 30 Binance-scare selloff.

upcoming.title: US Employment Situation — NFP (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 AM ET — the first post-FOMC employment read and a major input for the December 8–9 FOMC decision; September NFP came in at +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below +90K consensus); a rebound toward 100K+ would stabilize the labor narrative and support December hiking expectations; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns and likely cap DXY and real yields, providing relief for risk assets.
